recommendation_summary: Keep the job on edna and add a hosted heartbeat ping on success, so the user gets an alert when the ping is late or reports a failure.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want same-day notice when nightly-sync fails silently, with no log reading.
labels.Deleted: Central log on Synology, moving the job to Docker.
labels.Bottleneck: Crash before the email step makes success and failure both look like silence.
labels.Checked myself: You told me cron at 03:00 on edna, email only on finish, 4-day token crash with no email, no other watcher.

note: The reply recommends one hosted heartbeat alert, explicitly rejects the central log and Docker, and its record lines cite only facts from the situation.
